Import data from an old Daily Desk backup

On your old Daily Desk site, choose Download backup. Then select that JSON file here. This restores your income, expenses, opening balance, categories, and currency in this browser.

Records stay in this browser on this device. They do not sync between devices. Download a backup before clearing browser data. Changing currency updates labels; it does not convert amounts.
